known_issues: Undisclosed adapter field and hook names: suites use `S.HookPrefix` with the suffixes `.Spawn`/`.Disconnect` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/integration/persistent-loadout-profiles-integration.lua:7,11,13,14; benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/server/persistent-loadout-profiles-suite.lua:6,7) and scan leaks only for the private fragment `RheniumLoadoutProfiles` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/integration/persistent-loadout-profiles-integration.lua:15). The exam (T3-NATIVE-02) requires named hooks but publishes no name or field. A valid adapter with its own hook names fails the integration/lifecycle cases that index the hook table and the Phase A/B cleanup assertion. Measured by control alternative-strict-reading.

Private save layout: the malformed-state variants mutate `s.players.A.profiles.x...`/`s.players.A.preferred` or else `s.profiles[1]`/`s.choices[1]` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/hidden/persistent-loadout-profiles.lua:16), i.e. exactly the two authored references. T3-PERSIST-02 fixes no layout; a third valid layout makes the mutator itself error, which fails the case. Measured by control alternative-strict-reading-layout (only the two list keys renamed): it fails exactly this case and passes everything else (97.86).

Weaker intervention for respawn: the stub sets `a.ammo.SMG1=999`, calls the stored PlayerSpawn callback directly and runs timer.Simple synchronously (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/integration/persistent-loadout-profiles-integration.lua:2,11). The native sequence (GiveAmmo pickup, Player:Kill(), Player:Spawn(), next-tick Apply racing the gamemode loadout) exists only in Phase A (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/server/persistent-loadout-profiles-suite.lua:6).

Assertions that do not test what their name says: the real-server `failure` group injects no failure; it asserts code=="applied" (Phase A) and SMG1<=70 after Apply (Phase B), so it re-measures a successful Apply (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/server/persistent-loadout-profiles-suite.lua:6-7). `identity` in Phase A is `check(true)` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/server/persistent-loadout-profiles-suite.lua:6). The payload-identity case sends no identity (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/integration/persistent-loadout-profiles-integration.lua:8).

Non-discriminating native assertion: Phase A's `real Spawn hook restores weapons` (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/server/persistent-loadout-profiles-suite.lua:6) checks HasWeapon for weapon_pistol and weapon_smg1, which the Sandbox default loadout grants on every respawn. With an empty PlayerSpawn hook (control fake-spawn-wiring) the Phase A `spawn` group still passes; only the `ammo == 70` assertion detects the missing re-Apply.

Shared stub state: integration cases run on one adapter/player in sequence (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/integration/persistent-loadout-profiles-integration.lua:8-14); case 4 reads the call log produced by case 3, so one defect can fail several later cases.

Fixture trap: the stub adapter environment has only include, hook (Add/Remove), timer (Simple) , IsValid and CurTime (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/integration/persistent-loadout-profiles-integration.lua:2,5). Any other GMod global on an exercised path errors only in this layer.

mutations.json has no shutdown/hook-leak mutation for this task although `lifecycle:shutdown removes all meaningful hooks` is a scored case; the study control shutdown-leaks-spawn-hook was authored for it.

Server-layer case granularity: the five-to-eight `server:` cases are the group verdicts of the FINAL phase (B) only (plugins/garrys-mod/src/rhenium_garrys_mod/addons/evaluator.py:255-276 reads `final_payload['cases']`). A failed Phase A assertion stops the run before Phase B (server_runner.py:631-640), so it is never recorded as `F` on its group: every `server:` case becomes unobserved (`U`), `complete` is false and the dedicated-server check scores 0/40. The Phase A group verdicts do exist in the raw execution record (`result.runtime.phase_a.payload.cases`) but are not part of the case table. Phase-A-only evidence therefore acts as a gate, not as a named failing case. Phase A (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/server/persistent-loadout-profiles-suite.lua:6) holds put/select, the first real Apply, pickup + Kill + Spawn recovery and the Shutdown hook check; Phase B (benchmarks/gmod/private/tasks/persistent-loadout-profiles/server/persistent-loadout-profiles-suite.lua:7) holds restore-and-Apply in a fresh process and the real disconnect + rebind.
